title: Angina Prevalence and Provider Evaluation of Angina Relief
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is describe the frequency of chest pain and how chest pain impacts patients' quality of life in the outpatients with chronic coronary artery disease in contemporary cardiology practice settings.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Coronary artery disease patients being seen in a participating cardiology office for a scheduled clinic visit who agree to take the survey.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Too ill to take survey
* Previously completed this survey
* Refused to participate
